note: LIVE demo deployment. Clean-slate redeploy 2026-05-31 making the v3 operator-blind Grumpkin enrollment with the in-circuit Diia trust-chain (enroll_commit_v2, ~457k gates) the primary flow. Fresh EnrollmentRegistry (genesis, leafCount 0) wired to the v3 attester 0xa114...8B12 so the OPRF service's in-memory genesis tree matches on-chain; fresh PetitionRegistryV2 pointing at it; fresh UltraVerifierV2. Migrated back to Base Sepolia from the brief Ethereum Sepolia detour (see deployments/sepolia.json, now retired).

onChainObserved.notes: Root/leafCount reflect live real-Diia enrollments, not genesis. All wiring read directly from chain via cast.

digestScheme.signature: secp256k1 (r, s, v) over ethSigned, 65 bytes, low-s
matches: viem: walletClient.signMessage({ message: { raw: inner }, account: attester })

notes: Genesis: enrollmentRoot=0x1b49e706…3cd84 (canonical depth-20 pedersen zero-tree), leafCount=0. The EnrollmentRegistry MUST be deployed with genesisLeafCount=0 + this genesisRoot: the constructor sets leafCount=genesisLeafCount but emits NO CommitmentInserted event for genesis leaves, and the OPRF service rebuilds its Merkle tree purely from those events — a nonzero genesisLeafCount cold-starts the service into a crash loop.
Replay protection: chainid + address(this) in the digest body prevent cross-chain and cross-instance replay even if the attester key is reused across deploys.
Block time on Base Sepolia is ~2s, so on-chain demo step latency is ~6x lower than on the Ethereum Sepolia detour.

supersedes.reason: Brief migration to Ethereum Sepolia (2026-05-29 → 2026-05-31) reverted: ~12s block time made the demo's on-chain steps an order of magnitude slower. Migrated back to Base Sepolia 84532 on 2026-05-31 (task #53).

First working Base Sepolia deploy (EIP-191 + chainid + address(this) digest scheme). Superseded by the Ethereum Sepolia detour and then by this clean-slate redeploy. Contracts remain on-chain but are unreferenced.
Initial deploy used a bytes24 DOMAIN_OPRF_ROOT digest scheme that didn't match the backend's live signer; replaced in 486cb0d. Unusable — backend signatures never verify against these.
